summary: Completed focused desktop branding verification on external APP_URL. New WorkSpaceX assets are present on login/sidebar/metadata and public icon endpoints; focused Playwright branding spec passes.

integration_issues.flow: Post-login console/network hygiene during branding pass
integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs 500 for /ai-api/cloud during otherwise successful branding checks.
Runtime lock screen was not reachable in this account state (lock button absent); lock branding verified by static render source assertion only.

action_items: Investigate /ai-api/cloud 500 responses shown in console during normal app load.
If lock-flow runtime coverage is required for this branding task, provide/seed an ephemeral browser-local master-key state and re-run lock/unlock visual verification.
Optional cleanup: favicon link includes cache-busted '/favicon.ico?favicon...'; this is functional, but verify if strict static href matching is required by product acceptance.
critical_code_review_comments: Branding components correctly use approved PNG assets: LogoWord maps to /brand/workspacex-logo.png or /brand/workspacex-wordmark.png, and IconLogoMark embeds /brand/workspacex-mark.png.
Pre-hydration lock-pending brand override is in place via app/styles/brand.css using /brand/workspacex-logo.png.
Obsolete conflicting SVG icons are removed from repository paths: /app/app/icon.svg and /app/public/icon.svg not found.
seed_data_creation: No server-side seed data created. Browser-local onboarding skip and zoom were used in isolated test contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused branding spec added and passing: tests/e2e/54-branding-desktop.spec.ts. Public assets verified 200 with expected dimensions/transparency and /icon.svg returns 404. Remaining gap is runtime lock-screen verification in a state where lock is actually configured; static code assertion confirms new lock/access-wall logo usage.
rca of the issue: Observed non-blocking but repeated console 500 from /ai-api/cloud while executing branding-only flows. Reproduction: login to app and load shell; network panel/console logs /ai-api/cloud -> 500. Branding itself remains functional, but this is an integration noise issue that can mask real regressions.
